title: New Category opens a page with the General Matrix and its grid
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products and Services field shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows New Category.

Step 2:

  • A New Category page opens, not a dialog.
  • It shows a name field, a Pricing Matrix picker reading the General Matrix, QuickBooks Products and Services and Tax Exempt.
  • Below them the General Matrix's grid shows read-only, with no Edit.
  • Cancel and Create Category show in the page head, at the top right.
